paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 85:13; see also the entry Avin bar Chisda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 85:13 explicitly names Rava bar Rav Chisda, supporting 85:13 for the supplied locator פ״ה־יג.

The saved TE Bereshit Rabbah85:13 scalar explicitly names Rava bar Rav Chisda, supporting the85:13 reading over the older5:13 draft. The saved comparison from chapter5 is5:1 only: it does not support the historical claim of zero matches across the entire chapter. The untitled Avin bar Chisda pointer remains distinct from the heading and does not bind an identity.
